inputs.frames: FLU; every operation is linear or a norm of the (u,v) difference, so the same rows in FRD (v -> diag(1,-1,-1) v) give the FRD image of every output

dropout.description: 10 Hz reports, latency 0.1475 s; reports at k 40..69 invalid (ok False), then good again

silence.description: 10 Hz reports, latency 0.1475 s; NO report at k 40..69 (the k 38 sample ages; stale_s 0.6 applies)

gross.description: reports at k 20..27 pass the data gates but are +0.8 m/s in u (> gross 0.5 vs LP_1s(FD))

flip_mid_fade.description: invalid from k 40; one good report at k 50 (mid-fade); invalid again until k 70

engage_bad.description: engage (reset at k 0) with the newest sample invalid; good reports from k 6
